title: Goals Feature Flag — CLI Changes
description: Tour of CLI changes to catch server 404 errors when Goals is disabled and display friendly messages

steps.title: Import parseApiError
steps.description: Import the existing parseApiError utility from utils.ts which extracts the .error field from HTTP error response bodies.

steps.title: try block wraps switch statement
steps.description: The entire switch statement dispatching goals subcommands is now wrapped in try/catch. This covers list and get commands which lack local error handling.

steps.title: catch block with parseApiError
steps.description: Catches any error from goals commands, extracts the clean message via parseApiError, prints 'Error: <message>', and exits. For 404 from disabled Goals, this produces 'Error: Goals feature is not available.' instead of a raw HTTP error.
